purpose: Measure whether white antipodal copying defeats the current black AI on the spherical boards; no tuning or promotion.

whitePolicy.normal: Antipode of black's last move; pass after black passes.
whitePolicy.illegalAntipode: Current v2 depth 4 chooses that one white move, then copying resumes. Record every exception and its reason.
whitePolicy.symmetry: Measure loss of color/antipodal board symmetry separately from legality of the next copy.

common.seedFormula: baseSeed + size * 100000 + gameIndex * 1009; xorshift32 generates a fixed per-ply seed list

report: board scores before and after komi
completed games with exclusively legal mirror replies
first illegal copy / first asymmetric white turn
unique full move sequences per condition
statistics.reason: All games start empty with seeded AI tie-breaking; repeated trajectories are not independent opening samples.

stopRule: Complete all 96 declared games regardless of results. Report caps separately, do not assign them a winner.
verification: Replay every move and verify legality, antipodal policy or justified fallback, end score, exact ordinary v3 visits, source hashes and unique trajectories.
interpretation: Performance against this specified white policy; not a proof about optimal play. A game with any fallback is not evidence for pure copying alone. No human rank estimate or equal-compute claim.
